why: No major reviewer or authority answers the bundle-under-$300 question: the famous names here are a Verge news post, TechRadar and CNET deal posts on bundles with 45W/30W panels or $479 prices, a stale EcoFlow Black Friday post, general power station and panel guides, and a $1kWh DJI review. The rest of the results are a pile of single-product Pecron E300LFP pages (brand store, Walmart, eBay, spec sites, manual, trade fair listings), expired MorningSave flash deals, and under-$300 station lists that omit the panel. Only powersized's kit price guide approaches the question, without a $300 filter or testing. A focused page comparing real bundles under $300 with current prices and codes would stand out, much like our solar kit win.
